raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT run_id, rho, policy, quantile, lead_s, cold_start_s, superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'factorial' AND policy = 'forecast' AND quantile = 'p90'), p90_frontier AS (SELECT d.rho, MIN(f.provisioned_ws) FILTER (WHERE f.feasible) AS provisioned_ws, BOOL_AND(f.feasible) AS passes_in_aggregate, COUNT(*) AS current_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS superseded_rows FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.current_factorial f ON f.run_id = d.run_id WHERE f.window_name = 'aggregate' AND f.model = 'chronos' AND f.readiness = 'warm' GROUP BY d.rho), static_denominator AS (SELECT MAX(c.denominator_worker_seconds) AS static_worker_seconds FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio c ON c.run_id = d.run_id AND c.is_current = d.is_current WHERE d.is_current = true AND c.window_name = 'aggregate' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' AND c.denominator_window_mismatch = false) SELECT p.rho, p.provisioned_ws, s.static_worker_seconds, p.provisioned_ws / s.static_worker_seconds AS cost_ratio, ROUND((p.provisioned_ws / s.static_worker_seconds)::numeric, 2) AS cost_ratio_rounded, p.passes_in_aggregate, p.current_rows, p.superseded_rows FROM p90_frontier p CROSS JOIN static_denominator s ORDER BY p.rho
raw.observed: Cost ratios are 0.89 at rho=10, 0.62 at rho=15, 0.48 at rho=20, and 0.40 at rho=25; passes_in_aggregate=true and superseded_rows=0 at every rating.
raw.claimed: 0.89× static at rho=10 down to 0.40× at rho=25, passing in aggregate at every rating
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded aggregate p90-forecast rows pass at all four ratings and reproduce both claimed endpoint ratios after rounding.
